do_quit does not consume an argument; trailing words do not alter the mortal shortcut refusal (R1/R2/R5e).

The IS_NPC or missing-descriptor early return cannot be reached from a player descriptor's top-level interpreter row; it belongs to lifecycle/runtime teardown rather than this command surface (R4/R5e).
